title: Generalization Bounds via Vector-Valued $L_p$ Correlation $V_\alpha$
abstract: arXiv:2610.29425v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding generalization of randomized learning algorithms remains a central challenge. Mutual-information and total-variation bounds provide complementary ways to quantify data--hypothesis dependence, but they can behave quite differently in high-dimensional regimes. We study a one-parameter family of dependence measures, the vector-valued $L_p$-norm correlation $V_\alpha$, and derive generalization bounds whose dependence terms interpolate between total variation (TV) at $\alpha=1$ and variance and $\chi^2$ related behavior at $\alpha=2$. For $\alpha>2$, the H\"older-conjugate loss moment is below two, yielding heavy-tailed specializations that can remain finite even when the loss variance is infinite. A particularly interpretable specialization occurs at $\alpha=2$, where the bound can be expressed in terms of the variability of the algorithm's output density across datasets, $\int \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_S[p(w\mid S)]}~ dw$. translated_title: 基于向量值 $L_p$ 相关性 $V_\alpha$ 的泛化界
translated_abstract: 理解随机化学习算法的泛化能力仍然是一个核心挑战。互信息和全变差界为量化数据与假设之间的依赖性提供了互补的途径，但它们在高维情形下的表现可能截然不同。我们研究了一族单参数的依赖性度量——向量值 $L_p$ 范数相关性 $V_\alpha$，并据此推导出泛化界，其依赖项在 $\alpha=1$ 时的全变差（TV）与 $\alpha=2$ 时的方差及 $\chi^2$ 相关行为之间进行插值。对于 $\alpha>2$，Hölder 共轭损失矩小于二，由此得到的重尾特化形式即使在损失方差为无穷大时仍可保持有限。一个特别易于解释的特化出现在 $\alpha=2$，此时该界可以用算法输出密度在不同数据集之间的变异性 $\int \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_S[p(w\mid S)]}~ dw$ 来表示。
tldr: 该论文提出了一族单参数依赖性度量 $V_\alpha$ 并据此推导出新的泛化界，这些界在 $\alpha=1$ 时退化为全变差界、在 $\alpha=2$ 时与方差和 $\chi^2$ 行为相关，且在 $\alpha>2$ 时即使损失方差无穷大也能保持有限。
en_tdlr: This paper derives generalization bounds via a one-parameter family of dependence measures $V_\alpha$, which interpolate between total variation at $\alpha=1$ and variance/$\chi^2$-type behavior at $\alpha=2$, with heavy-tailed specializations for $\alpha>2$ that remain finite even when the loss variance is infinite.
